$comment: ADR 016 example 2: text_to_speech with managed playback and with a retrievable audio artifact. status 'proposed' means the shapes are decided but the 1.0 schemas do not accept them yet: the request schema change lands with #245, the artifact reference with #244. Until then packages/contracts/src/task-contract-fixtures.test.ts asserts every request here is rejected at /task/kind, which is also how an older consumer treats an unknown task. When #245 lands this file flips to 'current' and the same test validates it. The artifact object is a placeholder until #244 fixes its shape. The planner object is the projection onto route-planner-input's task (#243).

cases.description: Managed playback: run() resolves when audible playback has finished. The result holds no bytes. The region in de-AT is a preference (localeMatch 'language'); the provider reports it used de-DE, which is a success.

speech.text: Der Bus kommt in fünf Minuten.

cases.description: Cancelling a playback stream stops the audio; the terminal outcome is cancelled and carries the normalized output instead of partialText.

speech.text: Bitte steigen Sie an der nächsten Haltestelle aus.

cases.description: Retrievable audio: run() resolves once the artifact is fully materialized and nothing is played. The media types and the exact locale are hard requirements.
